meta.what: DirectSound calls of the original RcHcGame.dat (RedCat Spookkasteel, Davilex 2000), world 3, traced under Wine

time.zero: first sample (0.5 ms polling of the process memory) in which game+0x98, the current game state, is 3 = GS_GAME: the start of the first game frame after the world was loaded
time.resolution: Wine stamps trace lines in whole milliseconds
time.firstPlayNote: subtract firstPlay from every t for times relative to the first Play

meta.settingsNote: the copy ran with the owner's Player1.ini (only GameType and DifficultyLevel are set by the launch recipe); volumeIni on a buffer is its line in Settings\Volume.ini

frameRate.note: no frame limiter in the game; software OpenGL in Xvfb

sink.note: no audio device: ALSA file plugin into a reader that takes the stream at the played rate; mixerFramesPerSecond against the device rate shows play cursors ran at real time

audio.alignment: the first non-zero sample of the stream is put at t = 0.073 s, the first moment a playing buffer has a volume above -10000 (buffer 3); a sound enters the stream at the next mixer pass, up to about 35 ms after its Play
audio.note: Wine mixes in 32-bit float at the device rate; this file is that stream from the first game frame on, converted to 16 bit

meta.results: result "ok" = Wine logged no warn line for the call (it logs one on every failing path of these methods); values are given where Wine prints them (GetStatus, GetFrequency, Lock, AddRef/Release)
meta.merged: consecutive SetVolume / SetPan / SetFrequency calls on one buffer with the same argument are one event with n = number of calls and tLast = time of the last one
